title: 第9章 有钱就不要省着花
novel_title: 1960：九个妹妹把我宠上天(天下第九)
content_zh: 次日清晨。辰楠醒来，发现脑袋还是有些昏沉，精神力催生这一个技能也不能经常使用。虽然经常使用精神力有助于增强精神，可短时间内使用次数过多也会导致精神疲劳。甩了甩脑袋，意识进入空间，就发现空间里的那一颗南瓜苗发生了巨大的变化。别的果实比篮球大一些，唯独昨晚被催生的南瓜苗，上面的南瓜已经有脸盆那么大。这一根南瓜苗细算之下共有十八个南瓜，辰楠弯腰艰难抱起一个掂量了一番。“好家伙，这得有七八十斤一个啊！”辰楠惊讶地看着一片南瓜地，以前种植出来的东西也没有如此变态。或许是处于不一样的时代，所以效果也不一样。黑土地+灵泉溪水+精神力催生，这样的效果很强大。但精神催生这种事不能经常做，缺乏精神力导致脑袋胀痛的感觉太难受。“回去乡下之前，得先解决粮食问题。”辰楠思忖着，“还有爸的腿，也得想办法治治。”他想到灵泉溪水，他暗中在父母的饮水中滴入了几滴，效果虽不明显，但父亲的脸色似乎好了些。若是直接用来泡脚或者外敷，或许对腿伤有帮助。至于粮食，也不好搞，除了黑市，没有别的渠道能购买。想要在百货大楼里购买也不行，不仅要钱，关键还要票，现在缺粮饿肚子的人实在太多，很多时候有钱有票也买不到粮食，因为是定量的。他现在连钱都没有，肯定也没有多余的粮票。辰楠虽然没去过黑市，但也听说过一些传闻。那里鱼龙混杂，风险极大，但也是唯一能快速搞到粮食的地方。窗外阳光明媚，辰楠的心中却燃起了一团火。起身走出房间，老妈上班去了。老爸也不在家，肯定也是去了上班，不知道他的风湿腿好了没。哪怕腿脚还有点疼痛，但他肯定会坚持去轧钢厂上班，生怕请假扣了工资。如今家里就他一个人在家。夏日的清晨还算凉爽，他打了一盆井水，胡乱抹了把脸，冰凉的水刺激得他精神一振。“今天得去摸摸黑市的情况。”他对着水盆里的倒影自言自语。清晨的胡同里已经有了烟火气，国营饭店前围满了人。辰楠走到一个卖包子的窗口前，一股麦香和肉香扑鼻而来，让他不自觉地咽了咽口水。“同志，包子怎么卖？”辰楠问道。服务员是个围着白围裙的大妈，头也不抬地说：“肉包一毛五一个，二两粮票；菜包一毛一个，一两粮票。”辰楠觉得这价格对于他来说是真便宜，但这价格对于这个时代来说是真不便宜。他并没有省钱的念头，该吃吃该喝喝，现在可是长身体的时候，不多吃点不行啊！掏出四毛五分钱和六两粮票：“来三个肉包。”刚收获一批不义之财，该花还是要花的。他的人生信条就是：有钱就不要省着花。手上有那么多金子，没粮票还可以找人兑换。大妈麻利地用油纸包好三个肉包子递给他。辰楠接过热腾腾的包子，咬了一大口，香喷喷的，虽然是肉馅的，但面皮松软，油水很足。他三两口吃完一个，意犹未尽地舔了舔嘴唇。剩下的两个肉包他边走边吃，或许是香味太浓，引得路人纷纷侧头观看。“量很足啊！吃三个就有点撑着了。”辰楠心里满足，这个时代的东西就是量大。等辰楠停下脚步的时候，不知不觉中已经到了常伟家所在的胡同大院。常伟家住的是厂领导分配的筒子楼，有三四层楼高，每层居住的人挺多。筒子楼与大杂院的情况差不多，但这个时代或许更多人喜欢住筒子楼，虽然采光差点，但使用水电方便。辰楠想着既然到了这里，那不如待会再走。他在胡同口晃悠，不一会儿，就看到一个提着菜篮子的大妈从院里出来。辰楠上前搭话，“大妈，请问常伟家住哪一户？我是他同学，听说他昨天被人打了，我来看看他。”大妈打量了辰楠一眼，压低声音说：“你是他同学呀。”大妈也没怀疑什么，毕竟那常伟昨天是真受伤了。“可别提了，昨天常常伟不知被谁打了，脸肿得跟猪头似的。”“回来又被他爸臭打骂了一顿，闹得整个筒子楼鸡飞狗跳的。这会儿估计还在家养伤呢！”辰楠听了这话心里暗笑，表面上却装出关切的样子：“严重吗？要不要紧？”“应该没大事，就是皮肉伤。”大妈摆摆手，“不过常伟他爸气得够呛，说儿子在外面给他惹是生非。我看啊，小伟这段时间是别想出门了。”辰楠谢过大妈，转身离开。来都来了，他记得柳如意也住在附近，他又绕到柳如意家附近。柳家住在一个大杂院里，比常伟家普通多了。辰楠在对面胡同溜达了一圈。忽然他感到后面一阵风袭来，他一个闪身躲了过去，刚想一大嘴巴子抽过去，就听到一个熟悉的声音。“辰楠？真是你啊！你在这儿干嘛呢？”辰楠停下手，眼前站着的是个矮个子少年，穿着褪色的军便服，眼睛滴溜溜地转，透着机灵劲。他愣了一会儿，才从原主的记忆里找出这个人——赵小川。他的初中同学，毕业后没正经工作，整天在街上晃悠，是个有名的二流子。“赵小川，你怎么在这儿？”赵小川咧嘴一笑，露出两颗虎牙：“这话该我问你吧？在柳如意家附近转悠，怎么，还对人家不死心啊？”辰楠摆摆手：“别瞎说，我就是路过。”赵小川显然不信，但也没多问，而是神秘兮兮地凑近说：“听说你昨天把常伟给揍了？可以啊哥们，长本事了！”“你消息倒灵通。”他们的圈子不大，发生点什么事，很快就会传遍整个圈子。“这一片有什么事能瞒得过我赵小川？”小川得意地昂起头，随即又压低声音，“不过你得小心点，常伟那小子记仇，明着不敢来，暗地里肯定使绊子。”辰楠点点头，就怕常伟不动，动起来生活才有意思。“听说你跟柳如意闹掰了？”昨天发生的事他很清楚，听说连柳如意都差点被打，赵小川狐疑地看着辰楠，以辰楠的性格不应该啊！
content_en: Early next morning.When Chen Nan woke up, he found that his head was still a little groggy, and the mental power generation skill could not be used frequently.Although regular use of mental power can help strengthen your spirit, using it too often in a short period of time can also lead to mental fatigue.Shaking his head, his consciousness entered the space, and he discovered that the pumpkin seedling in the space had undergone tremendous changes.Other fruits are bigger than basketballs, except for the pumpkin seedlings that were spawned last night. The pumpkins on them are already as big as a basin.This pumpkin seedling counted a total of eighteen pumpkins. Chen Nan bent down and picked up one with difficulty and weighed it."Good guy, this must weigh seventy or eighty kilograms each!" Chen Nan looked at the pumpkin patch in surprise. Nothing grown before was so abnormal.Maybe it's because we are in different eras, so the effects are different.The effect of black soil + spiritual spring water + spiritual power is very powerful.But this kind of mental stimulation cannot be done often. The lack of mental power causes the feeling of swelling and pain in the head which is too uncomfortable."Before going back to the countryside, we must first solve the food problem." Chen Nan thought, "And dad's leg, we also need to find a way to cure it." He thought of the Lingquan stream, and secretly put a few drops into his parents' drinking water. Although the effect was not obvious, his father's complexion seemed to be better.If used directly for foot soaking or external application, it may be helpful for leg injuries.As for food, it’s not easy to get. There is no other way to buy it except the black market.It’s not possible to buy food in a department store. It requires not only money, but also tickets. There are too many people who are hungry and lack food. Many times, even if you have money and tickets, you can’t buy food because it is rationed.He doesn't even have money now, and he certainly doesn't have any extra food stamps.Although Chen Nan has never been to the black market, she has heard some rumors.It's a mixed bag and extremely risky, but it's also the only place where food can be obtained quickly.The sun was shining brightly outside the window, but a fire lit up in Chen Nan's heart.I got up and walked out of the room. My mother went to work.Dad is not at home either. He must have gone to work. I wonder if his rheumatic leg is healed.Even though his legs and feet still hurt a little, he would definitely insist on going to work at the steel rolling mill, for fear that asking for leave would deduct his salary.Now he is the only one at home.The summer morning was still cool. He took a basin of well water and wiped his face carelessly. The cold water stimulated his energy."I have to explore the black market today." He said to himself, looking at the reflection in the basin.There were already fireworks in the alley in the early morning, and people were crowding in front of the state-owned hotel.Chen Nan walked to a window selling steamed buns, and the aroma of wheat and meat hit his nostrils, making him swallow unconsciously."Comrade, how do you sell steamed buns?" Chen Nan asked.The waiter was an aunt in a white apron. She said without raising her head: "Meat buns are 15 cents each, and 20 taels of food stamps; vegetable buns are 15 cents, and 1 tael of food stamps." Chen Nan felt that the price was really cheap for him, but the price was really not cheap for this era.He has no intention of saving money. He should eat and drink as he should, but now that he is growing up, he must eat more!He took out 45 cents and 60 taels of food stamps and said, "Here are three meat buns." I had just harvested a batch of ill-gotten wealth, so I still had to spend it.His life creed is: if you have money, don’t spend it sparingly.With so much gold on hand, if you don’t have food stamps, you can still find someone to exchange them.The aunt quickly wrapped three meat buns in oil paper and handed them to him.Chen Nan took the hot bun and took a big bite. It was delicious. Although it was stuffed with meat, the dough was soft and full of oil.He finished one in two or three bites and licked his lips with unfinished content.He ate the remaining two meat buns while walking. Perhaps the aroma was too strong, which attracted passers-by to look sideways."The portion is quite large! You'll be a little full after eating three." Chen Nan felt satisfied. Food in this era is all about large portions.When Chen Nan stopped, he had unknowingly arrived at the alley compound where Chang Wei's family was located.Chang Wei's family lived in a tube building assigned by the factory leaders. It was three or four stories high, and there were quite a few people living on each floor.The situation of Tongzi Towers is similar to that of large courtyards, but in this era, perhaps more people prefer to live in Tongzi Towers. Although the lighting is not as good, it is convenient to use water and electricity.Chen Nan thought that since we were here, it would be better to leave later.He was wandering at the entrance of the alley, and after a while, he saw an aunt carrying a vegetable basket coming out of the courtyard.Chen Nan came up to talk, "Aunt, which household does Chang Wei live in? I am his classmate. I heard that he was beaten yesterday. I came to see him." The aunt looked at Chen Nan and lowered her voice and said, "You are his classmate." The aunt didn't doubt anything, after all, Chang Wei was really injured yesterday."Don't mention it. I don't know who beat Chang Wei yesterday. His face was swollen like a pig's head." "When he came back, he was beaten and scolded by his father again, which made the whole Tongzilou crazy. He is probably still at home recovering from his injuries!" Chen Nan secretly laughed after hearing this, but pretended to be concerned on the surface.He looked like: "Is it serious? Does it matter?" "It should be nothing serious, just a flesh wound." The aunt waved her hand, "But Chang Wei's father was very angry and said that his son was causing trouble for him outside. I think Xiao Wei won't even think about going out during this period." Chen Nan thanked the aunt and turned to leave.When he came, he remembered that Liu Ruyi lived nearby, so he went around to Liu Ruyi's house.The Liu family lives in a large courtyard, which is much more ordinary than the Chang Wei family.Chen Nan took a stroll in the alley opposite.Suddenly he felt a gust of wind coming from behind, and he dodged away. Just as he was about to slap him, he heard a familiar voice."Chen Nan? It's really you! What are you doing here?" Chen Nan stopped. Standing in front of him was a short boy, wearing faded military uniforms. His eyes were rolling, showing his intelligence.He was stunned for a while, and then he found this person from the original owner's memory - Zhao Xiaochuan.His junior high school classmate did not have a serious job after graduation and wandered the streets all day long. He was a famous second-rate boy."Zhao Xiaochuan, why are you here?" Zhao Xiaochuan grinned, showing two tiger teeth: "Should I ask you this? You are wandering around Liu Ruyi's house, why don't you give up on her?" Chen Nan waved his hand: "Don't talk nonsense, I was just passing by." Zhao XiaochuanObviously he didn't believe it, but he didn't ask much. Instead, he approached mysteriously and said, "I heard that you beat up Chang Wei yesterday? Okay, buddy, you're getting better at it!" "You're quite well-informed." Their circle is not big, and if something happens, it will spread throughout the circle very quickly."Is there anything in this area that you can hide from me, Zhao Xiaochuan?" Xiaochuan raised his head proudly, and then lowered his voice, "But you have to be careful. That boy Chang Wei holds a grudge. If he doesn't dare to come overtly, he will definitely cause trouble secretly." Chen Nan nodded, fearing that Chang Wei would not move and life would be interesting if he moved."I heard that you and Liu Ruyi had a falling out?" He knew very well what happened yesterday. He heard that even Liu Ruyi was almost beaten. Zhao Xiaochuan looked at Chen Nan suspiciously. With Chen Nan's character, he shouldn't!
